optimal_irrigation_method: Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) / Drip Paddy
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Install AWD field water tubes (perforated PVC pipes); irrigate only when water drops 15 cm below soil surface

critical_irrigation_stages: Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 21d), Tillering, Jointing, Flowering, Milking
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Apply light irrigations; never skip CRI irrigation (accounts for 25% yield reduction if skipped); stop watering during strong winds to prevent lodging

critical_irrigation_stages: Square Formation, Peak Flowering, Boll Development
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Adopt paired-row drip layout (saving 45% water); maintain soil moisture between 60-70% field capacity; avoid watering late in season to prevent vegetative regrowth

waterlogging_sensitivity: Moderate (Can tolerate brief flood if drained promptly)
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Incorporate 10 cm sugarcane trash mulch to retain 30% soil moisture; fertigate via drip to cut evaporation loss
Sow on Broad Bed Furrows (BBF) to provide both drainage during heavy rains and moisture conservation during dry spells

critical_irrigation_stages: Early Vegetative (Knee High), Tasseling, Silking, Early Dough
waterlogging_sensitivity: High (Stunts root growth and causes yellowing)
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Water stress during silking causes poor pollination and barren ears; ensure soil moisture is at least 65% during tasseling

drought_sensitivity: High (Irregular watering causes Blossom End Rot)
waterlogging_sensitivity: High (Induces root rot and bacterial wilt)
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Use silver-black reflective plastic mulch with drip irrigation; maintain uniform moisture to prevent fruit cracking and calcium deficiency

critical_irrigation_stages: Stolon Formation, Tuber Initiation, Tuber Bulking
waterlogging_sensitivity: High (Causes tuber rotting and lenticel opening)
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Maintain light, frequent irrigations; do not allow ridge tops to submerge; cease watering 10-12 days prior to harvest to toughen skin
Provide light sprinkler irrigation at pegging to facilitate penetration of pegs into soil; maintain loose friable soil surface

waterlogging_sensitivity: Very High (Excess moisture induces excessive vegetative growth and wilt)
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Grow primarily on conserved post-monsoon soil moisture; provide single supplemental irrigation at branching if soil is dry; do not irrigate at full bloom

critical_irrigation_stages: Post-Water Stress Bloom, Fruit Set, Fruit Growth
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Withhold water for 35 days before flowering ('Bahar treatment'); keep tree trunks completely dry using double-ring layout

critical_irrigation_stages: Vegetative Sucker Growth, Inflorescence Shooting, Bunch Development
waterlogging_sensitivity: High (Causes pseudostem lodging and root decay)
smart_water_conservation_strategy: Deliver daily micro-irrigation scaled with pan evaporation; keep soil at field capacity without puddling
